card.name: Number pieces inside larger numerals
card.fires_on: Digits or number words that start or sit inside a longer number, such as the 1 in 1998 or 16 hours, the 2 in 20°C, or Roman numerals like XX. Also big-number words like billion after one.

modes.label: First digit of multi-digit number
modes.description: A leading digit of a year, hour count or temperature, with more digits following.

modes.label: Roman or counted numerals
modes.description: Roman numerals or a count word such as billion that reads as part of a number.
modes.example: kill more than one<< billion>> aquatic organisms annually.

modes.label: Temperature digits
modes.description: The first digit of a Celsius value in parentheses after room temperature.

card.writes: It pushes Chinese words meaning "a/one" and pulls down counting words like 个 and 种, so it relates to number-plus-classifier continuations.
card.plain: It fires on the opening part of a number that is not finished yet, like the 1 in 16 hours or 1998.
